title: Vietnam — Da Nang & SAR Operations
subtitle: Tape 3a, Side 2 — Da Nang Harbor, USO Show, SAR Rescue

transcript.text: Alright, here's slide number one. This is a USS Ranger, an aircraft carrier that was up on Yankee Station there in the Gulf of Tonkin while we were there.
I took this picture as our ship was leaving Subic Bay.
Number two, this is another shot of a carrier Ranger taken there in Subic Bay.
This is a little bit more of a close-up, and if you look real close, you can see some of the planes there on the flight deck.
As a matter of fact, we rescued two pilots off the Ranger when one of their aircraft was downed up there on Saar Station.
Slide three, this shows Vietnamese fishing boats as our ship was entering Da Nang Harbor there on April 16th, the day I saw Bill.
Slide 4, this is an Army Huey helicopter taken in Da Nang Harbor.
I suppose Bill has mentioned these Hueys to you once in a while in his letters.
They play a pretty important part over there in Vietnam as rescue and gun helicopters.
